rationale: Stiven brings deep technical expertise in computer vision, ML, and embedded systems applied to medical AR—a field where Lisa is building at the intersection of XR, AI, and robotics. While Stiven is focused on surgical navigation software, Lisa's background in enterprise XR consulting and her current work in humanoid robotics and AI could offer strategic perspective on commercializing AR/XR solutions, especially as Braillic scales toward FDA approval and fundraising.
intro_message: Stiven Ding, meet Lisa Wang — you're both working on the bleeding edge of AR/AI and computer vision, and her XR expertise and founding experience could be valuable as you think through go-to-market and scaling Braillic.
